course.title: Unit 8 Once upon a Time【例句】
course.description: Section B What can stories teach us?

sentences.content: What do you think happens in this story?
sentences.english: What do you think happens in this story ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为这个故事里会发生什么？

wordDetails.definition: happen（第三人称单数）: 发生

sentences.content: Once upon a time, there was a mother duck.
sentences.english: Once upon a time , there was a mother duck
sentences.chinese: 从前，有一只鸭妈妈。

sentences.content: She had six little ducklings.
sentences.english: She had six little ducklings
sentences.chinese: 她有六只小鸭子。

sentences.content: Five of the ducklings were small and yellow,
sentences.english: Five of the ducklings were small and yellow
sentences.chinese: 五只小鸭子又小又黄，

sentences.content: but the last duckling was big and grey.
sentences.english: but the last duckling was big and grey
sentences.chinese: 但最后一只小鸭子又大又灰。

sentences.content: “He doesn’t look like us! What an ugly duckling!” the other ducklings said.
sentences.english: " He doesn't look like us ! What an ugly duckling !" the other ducklings said
sentences.chinese: “他长得和我们不一样！真是只丑小鸭！”其他小鸭子说道。

sentences.content: “That’s not nice!” said Mother Duck. “He’s still a duck like us!”
sentences.english: " That's not nice !" said Mother Duck ." He's still a duck like us !"
sentences.chinese: “这样可不好！”鸭妈妈说。“他依然是和我们一样的鸭子！”

sentences.content: At the river, the ugly duckling swam well, just like all the other ducklings.
sentences.english: At the river , the ugly duckling swam well , just like all the other ducklings
sentences.chinese: 在河边，这只丑小鸭和其他小鸭子一样游得很好。

sentences.content: But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away.
sentences.english: But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away
sentences.chinese: 但其他小鸭子仍然嘲笑他，叫他走开。

sentences.content: It made the poor duckling very sad, so he decided to search for a new home.
sentences.english: It made the poor duckling very sad , so he decided to search for a new home
sentences.chinese: 这让可怜的小鸭子非常难过，于是他决定去寻找一个新家。

sentences.content: He met many other birds, but all of them thought that he was ugly too.
sentences.english: He met many other birds , but all of them thought that he was ugly too
sentences.chinese: 他遇到了许多其他的鸟儿，但它们都觉得他也很丑。

sentences.content: They did not want him to live with them.
sentences.english: They did not want him to live with them
sentences.chinese: 他们不想让他和他们一起生活。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或否定

sentences.content: One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen. “May I stay with you?” he asked hopefully.
sentences.english: One day , the duckling met a cat and a hen ." May I stay with you ?" he asked hopefully
sentences.chinese: 一天，小鸭子遇到了一只猫和一只母鸡。“我可以和你们待在一起吗？”它满怀希望地问道。

sentences.content: But the two animals said no.
sentences.english: But the two animals said no
sentences.chinese: 但那两只动物拒绝了。

sentences.content: They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!
sentences.english: They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs !
sentences.chinese: 他们不喜欢他，因为他既不会发出呼噜声也不会下蛋！

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或否定

sentences.content: Some days later, the ugly duckling came to a lake.
sentences.english: Some days later , the ugly duckling came to a lake
sentences.chinese: 几天后，丑小鸭来到了一片湖泊。

sentences.content: There, he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers.
sentences.english: There , he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers
sentences.chinese: 在那里，他看见了三只美丽的天鹅，它们有着修长的脖颈和洁白的羽毛。

sentences.content: “I wish I looked like you!” he cried.
sentences.english: " I wish I looked like you !" he cried
sentences.chinese: “我真希望自己长得像你！”他喊道。

sentences.content: “My friend, you do look like us! Look in the water!” one of the swans said.
sentences.english: " My friend , you do look like us ! Look in the water !" one of the swans said
sentences.chinese: “我的朋友，你看起来真像我们！快看看水里的倒影！”其中一只天鹅说道。

sentences.content: The duckling looked down, and to his surprise,
sentences.english: The duckling looked down , and to his surprise
sentences.chinese: 小鸭子低头一看，惊讶地发现，

sentences.content: he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too!
sentences.english: he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too !
sentences.chinese: 他发现自己也变成了一只美丽的白天鹅！
